# Events

| [`accounts.current_account.AccountClosed`](./accounts.current_account.AccountClosed.md) | The account is closed ([ADR-PC-037](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-037-current-account-family.md): Active -> Closed, a business terminal). A closed account still holds the subject's PII until erased, so the GDPR-erasure transition remains legal from Closed. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`accounts.current_account.AccountCredited`](./accounts.current_account.AccountCredited.md) | A settlement CREDIT landed on the demand account ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md): ConfirmCredit -> Credit Movement) — the account RECEIVED money (a matured deposit, a loan disbursement, a coupon paid in). The credit was admitted UPSTREAM at ingestion by the family's credit-admission decider (a Closed/Erased account is refused by construction), so this fact is only ever appended for an account that could receive it. The Credit Movement is Observed in the [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) 'engine-internal already-effected' sense (the settlement saga already drove the cash leg and the CA records the landing), so no Originated header is emitted and the settlement predicate starts no SECOND saga on the account's own event (the loop-breaker). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date. |
| [`accounts.current_account.AccountDebited`](./accounts.current_account.AccountDebited.md) | A settlement CAPTURE landed a real DEBIT on the demand account ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md): ConfirmDebit -> HoldCaptured + Debit Movement) — a reservation turned into money actually leaving (funding a deposit at constitution, collecting a loan installment). The Debit Movement is Observed in the [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) 'engine-internal already-effected' sense, so no Originated header is emitted and no SECOND saga starts on the account's own event (the loop-breaker). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date. |
| [`accounts.current_account.AccountMarkedDormant`](./accounts.current_account.AccountMarkedDormant.md) | The account is marked dormant after an inactivity horizon ([ADR-PC-037](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-037-current-account-family.md): Active -> Dormant). The dormancy CRITERIA (the inactivity horizon) are pack/product policy, not on this event. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. Carries the structural product identity fixed at opening; the account's balances are NOT here — both the accounting and available balances are spine-owned folds over the movement ledger + hold set ([ADR-PC-033](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-033-account-abstraction-and-hold-lifecycle.md)), never a stored number. | [`operations.CreditReapplied`](./operations.CreditReapplied.md) | A previously-unapplied credit was reapplied once a live destination existed ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot 5). The account that could not receive the payout became receivable again (re-opened, reactivated, or a re-target to a valid account), so the held IOU is discharged and the money lands. A CROSS-CUTTING engine-declared event declared once in the spine under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3), folded per family as a no-op (the IOU/escheat ledger is spine-owned). The resolution key is a PURE FUNCTION of the original intent: resolution_intent_id = g(original_intent_id) from SettlementReferences.DeriveResolutionIntentId, never freshly minted, so a late apply of the ORIGINAL credit and this resolution structurally reference the same intent and the CA-apply command_id collapses at command_dedup to ONE landing (the double-pay guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) §Idempotency). A second CreditReapplied for an already-resolved intent is a reconciliation signal, not a double-pay. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, an input date. |
| [`operations.CreditUnapplied`](./operations.CreditUnapplied.md) | A matured/approved payout could not be delivered, so its credit is held UNAPPLIED rather than disgorged ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot 5). The money had nowhere to land (the beneficiary account is closed, dormant-past-revival, or does not exist), so instead of losing it the engine records a NAMED IOU: this amount is owed to this beneficiary under this economic intent, and the source keeps the funds (it stays payout-pending). A CROSS-CUTTING engine-declared event (the same posture as operations.Hold*), declared once in the spine under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) and folded per family as a no-op (the IOU/escheat ledger is spine-owned). The RESOLUTION key is NOT on this event: it is derived from intent_id by SettlementReferences.DeriveResolutionIntentId when a reapply is attempted, so a late original apply and the resolution collapse to one landing (the double-pay guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) §Idempotency). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, a machine reason code, an input date. |
| [`operations.NotificationDeliveryExhausted`](./operations.NotificationDeliveryExhausted.md) | Webhook delivery of one customer notification gave up for good: the notification service's delivery outbox retried the §D4 backoff schedule to exhaustion (10 attempts, ~12h) and dead-lettered the record — this event is the backbone announcement of that fact ([ADR-IC-011](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-011-async-saga-completion-notification.md) §D4/§P3 step 7). Produced by the NOTIFICATION service's own exhausted-event outbox ([ADR-IC-004](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-004-outbox-pattern-mechanism.md) discipline: the row is written in the SAME transaction as the DEAD_LETTERED flip), NEVER by the engine — the producing flow behind the notification is long committed and unaffected ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) slot 5, post-flag). Consumers are operational: an operator/alerting surface picks the notification up out of band; nothing retries off this event. Cross-cutting event under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5): the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka HEADERS, not here. NO PII — cleartext OR ciphertext ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): customer_id is an opaque recipient REFERENCE; last_error carries transport-status diagnostics only (an HTTP status line, a timeout message), never payload or subject data. |
| [`operations.NotificationDue`](./operations.NotificationDue.md) | A customer notification of template `template_ref` is due for an instance, with the structural data to render it ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md)). Engine-OWNED, engine-cross-cutting event under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) — the engine owns this schema and the `trigger_kind` taxonomy ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) §6). The engine emits only EVENT_DRIVEN + PRE_CONTRACTUAL; the enum RETAINS SCHEDULED for a DOWNSTREAM producer — the family-agnostic notification scheduler ([ADR-IC-019](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-019-family-agnostic-notification-platform.md)) reads the maturity-calendar / accrual projections and produces NotificationDue(SCHEDULED) itself, because the engine emits no clock-driven signal and runs no scheduler ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); the CloudEvents envelope (event_id, partition_key, valid_time/transaction_time, correlation_id) rides in Kafka HEADERS, NOT here. NO PII — cleartext OR ciphertext ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): customer_id is an opaque recipient REFERENCE the communications system resolves at render time against the engine's PII-resolve surface (returning null for a crypto-shredded subject); `data` carries STRUCTURAL interpolation values only (amounts, dates, rates, TAE), never the subject's name, NIF, or contact data. |
